own_solution.law: Energy conservation for the final temperature Tf = (m1 T1 + m2 T2)/(m1 + m2); entropy generated = sum m c ln(Tf/Ti) (isolated system, incompressible solids)

notes: Base: Tf = 318 K; S_gen = 900[2 ln(318/360) + 3 ln(318/290)] = 900(-0.248105 + 0.276511) = 25.57 J/K. With the hot block at 3.1 kg: Tf = 1986/6.1 = 325.574 K; S_gen = 900[3.1 ln(0.904372) + 3 ln(1.122668)] = 900(-0.311596 + 0.347124) = 31.98 J/K. The two 'small amount' sentences carry no number, unlike their apparent 1.1 kg variants; they are disconnected anyway. The 'earlier run' sentences rely on the reader taking the stated 2 kg as the current mass, which the problem text does state.
